items.title_zh: 观察:CCTV抓获菲律宾市长被火箭发射器击中一瞬间
items.summary: A mayor in the Philippines has survived a rocket launcher attack on his vehicle in broad daylight.
items.summary_zh: 菲律宾一名市长在光天化日之下在其车辆被火箭发射器袭击后幸存.
